title: Rein++: Efficient Generalization and Adaptation for Semantic Segmentation With Vision Foundation Models
mechanism: Rein-style learnable tokens on a frozen VFM for generalisation (Rein-G), plus an adaptation stage (Rein-A) that uses unlabelled target-domain images.
adaptation: 1024 px input (EL grey to 3 channels), frozen DINOv2-L or DINOv3-L, ResNet-34 stem as a stride-2/4 detail branch, 24-class head, house loss. Rein-G trained on the 5 labelled sources; Rein-A run on the 1,152 unlabelled multi half-cells from the pool (target-like for E1), never on E1 cells.
min_experiment: Arm: VFM-H + Rein-G, then + Rein-A. Baseline: house PF. Metric: E1 crack relF1@2 and E1 inactive IoU (one pre-registered opening), module-grouped 5-fold CV crack relF1@2. Kill: CV crack relF1@2 more than 0.005 below PF and E1 relF1@2 not at least +0.03 over PF (about 0.42) and E1 inactive IoU not above 0.24; Rein-A killed if it adds less than +0.02 E1 relF1@2 over Rein-G.
evidence: R: abstract only (TPAMI 2026, 5 citations); Rein-A / Rein-G split stated in abstract; numbers not read.
prior_overlap: none: no adapter, no target-domain adaptation and no ViT-L was ever tested (BRIEF section 5 lists UDA aimed at E1 as open).

alt_notes.adaptation: Rein-G on the 5 labelled sources; Rein-A on unlabelled pool cells resembling E1 (1,152 multi half-cells, CSIR), never E1 itself; drop the SAM boundary module for cracks.
alt_notes.min_experiment: Add Rein-A to the winning Rein arm; baseline Rein-G alone and house PF; metric E1 crack relF1@2; kill if not +0.02 over Rein-G.

alt_notes.adaptation: Rein-G on DINOv2-L or DINOv3 with a high-resolution CNN skip for cracks, trained on 478 cells. Rein-A with the half-cell pool as the unlabelled target. Overlaps the adapters direction; included for its UDA part.
alt_notes.min_experiment: Arm: Rein-G (+ Rein-A) with CNN skip, 3 seeds. Baseline: PF house. Metrics: E1 crack relF1@2 and inactive IoU, clean-49 crack IoU and mIoU_rob. Kill: E1 relF1@2 < PF + 0.03 and test crack IoU more than 0.02 below PF.
